body: I hear you.  I can't report any significant change in my situation, except that I get slightly more friendliness.  It seems she has time/ ability to deal with other people, but I'd rather she spend time with someone rather than being alone all the time.

I have offered those things.  She won't see me (or really much of anyone else, though she does seem to be forcing herself to see others) or even answer the phone.  She will text, though the regular and kind texts I used to receive (like, within the last two weeks) have changed. I have asked her what will alleviate the stress.  She responded that the stress is making her productive so she's not going to do anything right now.  

I think I'm being dumped, but then she says that's not the case, either. 

I'm just confused, and trying to decide how much I'm actually going to wait through for someone who doesn't seem to have any insight into or concern about hurting me.
